# JuliaApprox { #pyratapprox.JuliaApprox }

```python
JuliaApprox(julia_obj)
```

Base class for rational function approximations.

Wraps Julia's AbstractApproximation type, providing methods for evaluating
approximations, analyzing their properties, and managing the approximation
history.

## Attributes {.doc-section .doc-section-attributes}

| Name   | Type   | Description                                |
|--------|--------|--------------------------------------------|
| julia  |        | The underlying Julia approximation object. |

## Methods

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [check](#pyratapprox.JuliaApprox.check) | Check the quality of the approximation. |
| [degree](#pyratapprox.JuliaApprox.degree) | Get the total degree of the approximation. |
| [degrees](#pyratapprox.JuliaApprox.degrees) | Get the numerator and denominator degrees. |
| [get](#pyratapprox.JuliaApprox.get) | Get a property from the underlying Julia object. |
| [isconverged](#pyratapprox.JuliaApprox.isconverged) | Check whether the iteration reached the requested tolerance. |
| [isempty](#pyratapprox.JuliaApprox.isempty) | Check if the approximation is empty/undefined. |
| [poles](#pyratapprox.JuliaApprox.poles) | Compute the poles of the approximation. |
| [residues](#pyratapprox.JuliaApprox.residues) | Compute poles and their residues. |
| [rewind](#pyratapprox.JuliaApprox.rewind) | Rewind the approximation history by n steps. |
| [roots](#pyratapprox.JuliaApprox.roots) | Compute the zeros of the approximation. |
